description: Fires a burst of 1 to 16 pulses each time it is triggered, timed by its own clock or by one you patch in

params.text: Sets how many pulses make up the burst, 1 to 16
Sets the rate of the internal clock: 1Hz to 32Hz with RANGE at S, and 16Hz to 1024Hz with RANGE at F
Sets how far the rate voltage moves the internal clock, and in which direction; at full travel each volt doubles or halves the rate
F runs the internal clock from 16Hz to 1024Hz, S from 1Hz to 32Hz
ON lets a new trigger interrupt a burst and start it again; OFF makes a trigger take effect only once the burst has finished
Sets how far the pulse count voltage moves the number of pulses, and in which direction; at full travel 10V covers the whole 1 to 16 range
Starts a burst as though a trigger had arrived
Sets the chance of each pulse in the burst firing, 100% fully clockwise and falling as it is turned back; a pulse that does not fire is counted towards the total anyway
Sets how far the probability voltage moves the chance of a pulse firing, and in which direction, from -1 to +1

inputs.text: Takes an outside clock in place of the internal one; the burst then starts on the next rising edge here rather than at the trigger
Moves the rate of the internal clock, by the amount and direction set on the rate attenuverter
A rising edge here starts a burst
Moves the number of pulses in the burst, by the amount and direction set on the pulse count attenuverter
Moves the chance of each pulse firing, by the amount and direction set on the probability attenuverter

outputs.text: The pulses of the burst at 10V, each one as wide as the clock pulse that produced it
A 1ms 10V trigger at the start of each burst
10V from the start of the burst until the end of its last pulse
A 1ms 10V trigger when a burst finishes

notes: SX-CV8, SX-OUT8 and SX-TRIG8 add outputs to this module when one is placed immediately to its right; there is no menu entry here that adds one for you

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
